method: 486 matched same-page GPU-finish/one-pixel-readback renders:9components×3profiles×on/off×3alternating rounds×3samples. Native loop held, actual owning scene objects/uniforms, no other browser load. Trees in forest; flowers and character at street; clouds/aircraft in sky; snow at winter street; chimneys/smoke at roof inspection; combined at snowy roof inspection, only the simultaneous events admitted by the shared profile budget (Eco oneevent). Explicit diagnostic event placement for active-event cost; not a walking or ordinary rarity proof. Off disables just one feature, except combined removes all15D props/events. Snow toggles actual source-owner coating specialization plus flakes; clouds remove sky layer and shared cloud-shadow amount. Marginal timings are scenario-specific and cannot be added together. No allocation-disposal/memory-saving claim from visibility changes. Software SwiftShader, not physical GPU or Android FPS.
